_comment: Where the Dictionary's concepts come from (config/dictionary). They are not listed here: since 2026-10-21 a concept is a curator's own kind-39998 header that points at itself, so adding one is a publish, not a deploy. From 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-21 they were entries on a Demo Dictionary Concepts list; before that, this file listed them. Both are in its git history.
_curatorTag: Dictionary Concept Curator, Vinney's tag (2026-10-10). The curators are the people the house (the server's NIP-05 `_`, discovered, never configured) has tagged with it — the house too, only if it tagged itself. The house applies it in the Brainstorm UI like any other person tag; polarity -1 disputes it.
_roles: Concepts the app relies on, kept out of the Dictionary's view and search: infrastructure, not demos. PROVISIONAL (2026-10-01) url-templates: Vinney's canonical URL Templates list (self-b); its items carry ['url-template', <RFC 6570 level-1 template>] and a name, and a header pins one by event id with ['link', <id>, <relay>, <placeholder>, <field>, …] (lib/linkTemplates). The link picker reads its governing list for the reader: their copy, their Assistant's, else this one. Its items still render through it.
_views: Concepts with a tier-three view (ADR 0007): a hand-made page for a community concept, keyed by its coordinate so every copy of it (the house's, the reader's) gets the same page. The view still reads fields through the governing definition; it only decides how they look. A concept not listed here renders the tier-two way (DListItemHero); tier three plugs in from above (components/items/ItemPage, TierThreeProvider), never from inside tier two.
_pending: URLs — no kind-39998 URLs concept exists on any relay (searched dcosl, tags.brainstorm.world, staging, tapestry; 2026-10-01). Decision 2026-10-01: GitHub Accounts first, URLs once someone authors it. Its coordinate is permanent once copies point at it, so choose the author first.
